pages.ko: "으앙— 축축해!" 아침부터 호야가 울어요. 밤새 기저귀가 촉촉하게 젖어서 엉덩이가 찝찝해요. 아기 호야는 아직 쉬가 마려운 걸 잘 몰라요.
pages.t: "Waaah — I'm all wet!" Baby Hoya was crying first thing in the morning. Her diaper had gotten soggy overnight, and her bottom felt uncomfortable. Little Hoya doesn't yet know how to tell when she needs to pee.

pages.ko: 엄마가 예쁜 팬티를 입혀 줬어요. 그런데 놀다 보니 또 쉬— 바닥에 웅덩이가 졸졸. "괜찮아, 괜찮아." 엄마는 웃지만, 호야는 눈치가 보여서 고개를 푹 숙여요.
pages.t: Mom put pretty new underwear on Hoya. But while she was playing, she peed again — a little puddle trickled onto the floor. "It's okay, it's okay." Mom smiled, but Hoya felt embarrassed and hung her head low.

pages.ko: 엄마가 아기 변기를 가져왔어요. 그런데 호야는 변기가 조금 무서워요. "싫어— 안 앉을래!" 발을 동동, 몸을 배배 꼬며 도망가요.
pages.t: Mom brought over a little potty. But Hoya felt a bit scared of it. "No — I don't want to sit on it!" She stomped her feet, squirmed her whole body, and ran away.

pages.ko: 엄마가 호야를 폭 안고 손을 꼭 잡아 줬어요. "엄마랑 같이 해 보자. 하나도 안 무서워." 옆에서 형 호리도 씩 웃어요. "형도 처음엔 그랬어! 할 수 있어!" 호야는 엄마를 빤히 올려다봐요.
pages.t: Mom hugged Hoya close and held her hand tight. "Let's try it together with Mom. There's nothing scary about it at all." Beside them, big brother Hori grinned. "I was just the same at first! You can do it!" Hoya looked up at Mom, staring hard.

pages.ko: 엄마가 알려 줬어요. "한꺼번에 안 해도 돼. 조금씩, 한 걸음씩!" 먼저 변기에 살짝 앉아만 보기. "우와, 앉았네!" 그것만으로도 엄마가 손뼉을 짝짝, 형도 폴짝폴짝.
pages.t: Mom explained gently. "You don't have to do it all at once. Just a little at a time, one step at a step!" First, just try sitting on the potty for a moment. "Wow, you sat down!" Even for that, Mom clapped her hands, and big brother hopped up and down with joy.

pages.ko: 엄마가 배를 살살 만지며 알려 줬어요. "배가 간질간질하면, 그게 쉬 신호란다. 그럼 얼른 가면 돼!" 옆에서 형 호리가 고개를 끄덕끄덕. "형도 처음엔 그랬어!" 호야는 자기 배에 손을 얹고 간질간질을 느껴 보기로 했어요.
pages.t: Mom rubbed Hoya's tummy gently and explained. "When your tummy feels tickly, that's the signal that you need to pee. Then you just hurry over!" Beside her, big brother Hori nodded along. "I was just the same at first!" Hoya put her hand on her own tummy and decided to try feeling for that tickly feeling.

pages.ko: 얼마 뒤, 호야 배가 간질간질! "쉬 마려워!" 호야는 아장아장 변기로 달려가 앉았어요. 쪼르르— 성공이에요! "쉬야 쑥, 참 잘했어요!"
pages.t: A little while later, Hoya's tummy felt tickly! "I need to pee!" Hoya toddled quickly to the potty and sat down. Trickle trickle — success! "Out it goes, well done, Hoya!"

pages.ko: 호야는 어깨가 으쓱! 엉덩이도 뽀송뽀송, 기분이 날아갈 듯해요. "나 혼자 했어!" 엄마가 호야를 번쩍 안아 빙글빙글 돌려 줬어요.
pages.t: Hoya's shoulders puffed up with pride! Her bottom felt clean and dry, and she felt like she could float away. "I did it all by myself!" Mom scooped Hoya up and spun her around and around.

pages.ko: 이제 호야는 배가 간질간질하면 스스로 말해요. "쉬 마려워! 화장실 갈래!" 하나 바지 내리기, 둘 변기에 앉기, 셋 다 하면 손 씻기! 오늘도 아장아장 혼자 성공. "쉬야 쑥, 참 잘했어요!"
pages.t: Now, whenever her tummy feels tickly, Hoya says so herself. "I need to pee! I'm going to the bathroom!" One, pull down your pants, two, sit on the potty, three, wash your hands when you're done! Today too, she toddled off and succeeded all on her own. "Out it goes, well done, Hoya!"

pages.ko: 밤이 되자 엄마가 호야를 폭 안아 주었어요. "우리 호야, 이제 형아처럼 다 컸네!" 조금씩 하다 보니 혼자서도 척척. 실수해도 괜찮아요. 우리는 조금씩 크니까요. "쉬야 쑥, 참 잘했어요!"
pages.t: When night came, Mom hugged Hoya tight. "Our Hoya is all grown up now, just like her big brother!" Bit by bit, she learned to do it all on her own, smoothly. It's okay to have accidents — we all grow up little by little. "Out it goes, well done, Hoya!"

overview.ko: 변기를 무서워하던 호리가 조금씩 다가가 스스로 응가에 성공하는 배변훈련 생활동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a potty-training life-habits story about a little one who was afraid of the potty, gradually getting used to it and succeeding at using it all by herself.

lessons.t: Gain confidence in using the potty.
Learn to view using the bathroom in a positive way.

readingTips.ko: '응가 쑥, 시원해!' 후렴을 밝고 신나게 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the "out it goes, all clean!" refrain in a bright, cheerful voice.
Give plenty of praise whenever your child succeeds.
